about: Lines of work for RESULTS.md and the site's proofs page. An epic is placed by its name (the ID without its date), then by its research program, then in the fallback line. Edit this file to move an epic.

lines.name: Foundations: the knot and its readings
lines.description: The knot test, what knots hide and remember, holes, choice, and where emergence lives.

lines.name: Holes, depth and Tseitin proof complexity
lines.description: How deep a hidden bit is: degree and size of refutations of charge networks, and of the spaces the knot builds.

lines.name: Composing like cycles: the algebra of knots
lines.description: Which laws let knots compose the way cycles do, and what that forces.

lines.name: Native complexity: hubs, counting and approximation
lines.description: What networks of knots can decide, count and approximate without hubs.

lines.name: Three-fold spaces and counting on them
lines.description: The spaces where the not-all-equal knot closes up: Fano atoms, handles, amplitudes, signs and counting.

lines.name: Native creation, genus and selection
lines.description: What a removal creates in the knot's spaces, how far it reaches, and how selection reads handles.

lines.name: Space from a law: moves, signs, gaskets, rulers and circles
lines.description: Which local laws survive the moves of a space, with and without signs, the self-similar spaces a knot builds, and the rulers, planes and circles that bond distance measures.

lines.name: Tori, twists and direction
lines.description: Fair contacts on tori: criticality, twist sectors, walls and the cost of reading a direction.

lines.name: Counting maps from three-manifold groups
lines.description: Patterns of patterns in three dimensions: when counting colourings of knots and manifolds is hard.

lines.name: Res(⊕) follow-ups
lines.description: Checks and extensions of Braun's formal Res(⊕) lower bound.

fallback.name: Other results
fallback.description: Results not yet placed in a line of work.
